title: SickKids data breach exposes employee and job applicant info
summary: The Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids) has disclosed that the personal information of some current and former employees, as well as job applicants, was exposed in a "cybersecurity incident." The hospital says the breach stemmed from a flaw in third-party software.
